properties.name: Items
properties.description: The top-level entries of the menu bar.
properties.usage: Add menus from code.
properties.expectedEffect: A File entry appears on the menu bar.

properties.name: Dock
properties.acceptedValues: Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Fill, None
properties.description: The edge of the form the menu bar attaches to.
properties.usage: Keep the menu at the top.
properties.expectedEffect: The menu spans the full width of the form.

properties.name: RenderMode
properties.description: The renderer that draws the strip.
properties.usage: Use System for a classic look.
properties.expectedEffect: The menu is drawn with the system look.

properties.name: ShowItemToolTips
properties.description: Whether the items show tool tips.
properties.usage: Add hints to menu entries.
properties.expectedEffect: Hovering an item shows its ToolTipText.

properties.name: MdiWindowListItem
properties.description: The menu item that lists the open MDI child windows.
properties.usage: Create the Window menu of an MDI application.
properties.expectedEffect: Open child windows are listed in that menu.

properties.name: Items
properties.description: The entries of the pop-up menu. Attach the menu to a control with its ContextMenuStrip property.
properties.usage: Build the menu from code and assign it to a control.
properties.expectedEffect: Right-clicking the list shows the menu.

properties.name: SourceControl
properties.description: The control that displayed the menu. Valid while the menu is open, for example in Opening or in a click handler.
properties.usage: Find out which control the user right-clicked.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the control that opened the menu.

properties.name: ShowImageMargin
properties.description: Shows the left column reserved for item images.
properties.usage: Hide the column when no entry has an icon.
properties.expectedEffect: The menu becomes narrower.

properties.name: ShowCheckMargin
properties.description: Shows the column reserved for check marks.
properties.usage: Let entries show a checked state.
properties.expectedEffect: Space for check marks appears on the left.

properties.name: Items
properties.acceptedValues: ToolStripButton, ToolStripLabel, ToolStripComboBox, ToolStripSeparator and others
properties.description: The items shown on the toolbar.
properties.usage: Add buttons from code.
properties.expectedEffect: A Save button appears on the toolbar.

properties.name: Dock
properties.acceptedValues: Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Fill, None
properties.description: The edge of the container the toolbar attaches to.
properties.usage: Place a toolbar below the menu.
properties.expectedEffect: The toolbar spans the container width.

properties.name: GripStyle
properties.description: Whether the drag handle at the start of the strip is shown.
properties.usage: Hide the handle on fixed toolbars.
properties.expectedEffect: The handle disappears.

properties.name: ImageScalingSize
properties.description: The size to which item images are scaled.
properties.usage: Use larger icons on high-resolution screens.
properties.expectedEffect: Icons are shown at 24 by 24 pixels.

properties.name: LayoutStyle
properties.description: How the items are arranged.
properties.usage: Show a vertical toolbar.
properties.expectedEffect: Items stack from top to bottom.

properties.name: RenderMode
properties.description: The renderer that draws the strip.
properties.usage: Switch between flat and classic looks.
properties.expectedEffect: The strip uses the Professional look.

properties.name: ShowItemToolTips
properties.description: Whether the items show tool tips.
properties.usage: Turn off tips when they are not needed.
properties.expectedEffect: No item tips appear.

properties.name: Items
properties.description: The items shown on the status bar.
properties.usage: Add a message label.
properties.expectedEffect: A label with the text Ready appears.

properties.name: Dock
properties.acceptedValues: Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Fill, None
properties.description: The edge of the form the status bar attaches to.
properties.usage: Keep the status bar at the bottom.
properties.expectedEffect: The bar spans the bottom of the form.

properties.name: SizingGrip
properties.description: Shows the resize handle at the right end of the bar.
properties.usage: Hide it on fixed-size forms.
properties.expectedEffect: The handle disappears.

properties.name: Stretch
properties.description: Whether the strip stretches to fill the width of its container. With Spring on a label, items can fill the space.
properties.usage: Keep the bar full width.
properties.expectedEffect: The strip fills the available width.

properties.name: Checked
properties.description: Whether the button is shown pressed.
properties.usage: Show an active tool such as Bold.
properties.expectedEffect: The button looks pressed.

properties.name: CheckOnClick
properties.description: Makes the button toggle its Checked state when clicked.
properties.usage: Build toggle buttons.
properties.expectedEffect: Each click flips Checked and raises CheckedChanged.

properties.name: AutoToolTip
properties.description: Shows Text as the tip when ToolTipText is empty.
properties.usage: Turn it off to show no tip.
properties.expectedEffect: Hovering shows nothing unless ToolTipText is set.

properties.name: IsLink
properties.description: Makes the label behave like a hyperlink.
properties.usage: Add a help link to a status bar or toolbar.
properties.expectedEffect: The text is shown as a link and can be clicked.

properties.name: LinkColor
properties.description: The color of the link text when IsLink is true.
properties.usage: Match the link color to your design.
properties.expectedEffect: The link is drawn in the new color.

properties.name: LinkBehavior
properties.description: When the link text is underlined.
properties.usage: Underline only on hover.
properties.expectedEffect: The underline appears on hover.

properties.name: ComboBox
properties.description: The ComboBox control hosted inside the item.
properties.usage: Reach properties that the item itself does not expose.
properties.expectedEffect: The hosted drop-down list is wider.

properties.name: Items
properties.description: The entries in the drop-down list.
properties.usage: Fill the list from code.
properties.expectedEffect: The list shows the three entries.

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.acceptedValues: -1 or an index of an entry
properties.description: Zero-based index of the selected entry.
properties.usage: Select a default value.
properties.expectedEffect: The second entry is shown.

properties.name: SelectedItem
properties.description: The selected entry itself.
properties.usage: Read the chosen value.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the chosen entry or null.

properties.name: DropDownStyle
properties.description: Whether the user may type or only pick from the list.
properties.usage: Allow only the listed values.
properties.expectedEffect: The text area becomes read-only.
